title: IntelSetup sets memory frequency 2400 on DDR4-2133 RDIMMs
description: Active IntelSetup Data records (NVAR 67/97) set Memory Frequency 1248=13 (2400); the defaults are Auto. Enforce POR 1294=2 (Disabled) is the shipped default, so MRC does not limit frequency to the DIMM rating. Live dmidecode shows four Micron 36ASF2G72PZ-2G1A2 DDR4-2133 RDIMMs configured at 2400 MT/s, a 12.5% memory overclock. This fits training that stops at b7, OS freezes from memory errors and outcomes that change with any DIMM or GPU change: a stuck PEI boot writes no NVRAM, so only the hardware differs between attempts. The setting is stored in NVRAM, and a CMOS clear does not reset it (D01: NVRAM resets only on store damage).
not_established: PR9 setup was not checked. The setting does not by itself explain community reports on default settings.
remediation: Not the root cause: forced 2133 and unrelated desktop UDIMMs fail the same way. Keep as an aggravating condition.
